submitInterest.title: Express interest
submitInterest.description: Send Hazel the core institution and representative details needed to review your inquiry. This does not create a portal account.
submitInterest.requiredNote: Required fields are marked with an asterisk. Local development only—submission creates a synthetic Hazel case.
submitInterest.eligibleDescription: Your institution met the temporary RAFA testing threshold and can continue through the local invitation path.
submitInterest.rejectedDescription: Your institution did not meet the temporary RAFA testing threshold. A secure onboarding path was not created.
submitInterest.hazelOnly: Your Hazel inquiry and institution record have been created. No Coverbase intake was created during Submit Interest.
submitInterest.rafaDescription: Verified through the Bank Profile API with score {{score}}.
submitInterest.rafaRejectedDescription: The Bank Profile API returned score {{score}}, below the temporary testing threshold.
submitInterest.invitationDescription: Mocked locally; the private HOP case starts at NDA.
submitInterest.invitationNotCreatedDescription: The inquiry remains public and does not advance to NDA.

legalName.label: Legal institution name
legalName.hint: Use the institution’s complete legal name.

fdic.label: FDIC certificate number
fdic.hint: Hazel uses this number to match your institution to authoritative FDIC records.

contactName.label: Contact name
contactName.hint: Enter the person Hazel should contact about this inquiry.

contactEmail.label: Business email
contactEmail.hint: Hazel will send the inquiry response to this address.

validation.fdic: Enter the FDIC certificate number using digits only.
validation.email: Enter a valid business email address.
validation.verifyFdic: Verify and select the institution matching this FDIC certificate number.
